description: Drop-off minute of day equals pickup minute of day plus elapsed duration, reduced modulo 1,440 minutes.
rationale: The metadata explicitly states that dropoff_minute_of_day is derived from pickup_minute_of_day plus duration with midnight wraparound.
check_code:
def check(df):
    expected = (df["pickup_minute_of_day"] + df["duration"]) % 1440.0
    circular_error = ((df["dropoff_minute_of_day"] - expected + 720.0) % 1440.0) - 720.0
    return circular_error.abs() <= 1e-6
